# Generated by go run ./cmd/compose from the agent VM source. Don't edit by hand.
#
# Five processes (docs/22, the keys plan §11.2), each in its own container with its own uid, linked only by unix
# sockets: agentd (front door and runtime; no network), runner (runnerd: the brain in a gVisor sandbox, rootless
# runsc; no network, no keys, no capabilities), gatewayd (service "agentvm": the only network and the only way
# in), vaultd (the API keys; no network) and unlockd (the split-key unlock: the only one with dstack's socket and
# the root key; no network). A one-shot setup container (root, no network) gives them their directories first.
# The tunnel: our patched, reproducibly built cloudflared (/tacy/cloudflared, sha256
# 1c8c92c803f5d919c51bf01e1ce8d642d3ec05b51326c214eff756ed4221f0dd; it refuses configs the edge pushes, has no
# management service and no WARP or private-network routing) runs in gatewayd's container, confined: gatewayd's
# launcher (root with SETUID and SETGID only) starts gatewayd as 10001 and cloudflared as 10006, both with no
# capabilities; cloudflared's uid can reach no vault, agentd, unlockd or dstack socket, only gatewayd's ingress
# allowlist (a probe as its uid checks this before every start). The token is leased from vaultd after the unlock.
# gatewayd publishes no port and nothing listens on 8080: the tunnel is the only way in.
#
# key_provider none (Fix B): the data disk is under a key made inside the TD at boot, so there is no pre-launch
# script; setup makes unlockd's cache directory in the host's /run (tmpfs). Every service sets ulimits core 0.
#
# Every image is named by digest only: the pinned distroless base (gcr.io/distroless/static-debian13@sha256:2293b36c7c9082bf4115aab724b4d2cddec82c8eba39bf27ac0517e159acf150)
# plus one layer with the binaries at /tacy/<name>; runnerd's image also holds the brain and, in a layer of its own,
# gVisor 20261012.0 at /tacy/gvisor (Google's release https://storage.googleapis.com/gvisor/releases/release/20261012.0/x86_64/gvisor.tar.bz2,
# sha256 180dd277f657c1478f09490e8a9a595f7378257510b43d1d3694a769aef9ed02, each binary checked; its Apache-2.0 LICENSE at
# /tacy/gvisor/LICENSE). Rebuild them from the tagged source (scripts/reproduce.sh) to get the same digests.
# Binaries (linux/amd64, sha256):
#   agentd   8a9a206444bbca67c12938f6cb6bbf8ddf3699f2861bcf254fad6ac832f53f97
#   brain    7c984294c1b91fd5c27fb407d655bb2536b35e427b23b6d5082055e73d88cf60
#   gatewayd b2cc875ea9c9b2ca1386a8a5b93b4b0324671bcafadbb04cfb8eb9de1c9aaded
#   runnerd  b1c1a2432beaf866395941d4d598ade89a0e885e226c6e13c5d2a4c359990bcb
#   setup    80f380d97b1cc77da758d69ba978e5f09c720f10ef853f6afa06e06ffa006de6
#   unlockd  4d5abac2cea48948eec7052fef2f1045cf2e3c423e78117b6333b05937c40619
#   vaultd   b53eb0b5e61ffa016994b3cffac78fc2501b0babec0b4cec6dd35a70122c42ae
#            56996c546dbafd5716e1d09e307a131d97eb3b6483c22a1178631751f3e0392f (gVisor runsc)
#            1755e10a4c9d1db4973c0155497348db3737543b4c2e6a9f663a271ee71433d5 (gVisor gvisor-bin/gvisor_sentry)
#            46d5c028723ac5fbe40b863f95100f15a00d2aa0cd39c69d892500a988c930bd (gVisor gvisor-bin/gvisor-sentry-prewarmer)
#            03af90d07ea466c10ecc3e3ba839b2a59540959dd3286aea3886917cba850c11 (gVisor gvisor-bin/runsc-fd-parking)
services:
  setup:
    image: ghcr.io/tacyhq/tacy/setup@sha256:7c33f77d06d41b1f14c0729fd52abbabd657ec5e418e16fd17deac35bb607a0e
    entrypoint: ["/tacy/setup"]
    network_mode: none
    restart: "no"
    logging:
      driver: none
    ulimits:
      core: 0
    user: "0:0"
    read_only: true
    cap_drop: [ALL]
    cap_add: [CHOWN, DAC_OVERRIDE, FOWNER]
    security_opt: ["no-new-privileges:true"]
    volumes:
      - agentsock:/run/tacy/agent
      - vaultsock:/run/tacy/vault
      - runnersock:/run/tacy/runner
      - opssock:/run/tacy/ops
      - unlockagent:/run/tacy/unlock
      - unlockvault:/run/tacy/unlockv
      - unlockgw:/run/tacy/unlockgw
      - /run/tacy-unlock:/run/tacy-unlock
      - /run/tacy-tasks:/run/tacy-tasks
    command: ["-dir", "/run/tacy/agent=10003:10001:0770", "-dir", "/run/tacy/vault=10002:10001:0750", "-dir", "/run/tacy/runner=10004:10003:0750", "-dir", "/run/tacy/ops=10001:10001:0750", "-dir", "/run/tacy/unlock=10005:10005:0750", "-dir", "/run/tacy/unlockv=10005:10005:0750", "-dir", "/run/tacy/unlockgw=10001:10001:0750", "-dir", "/run/tacy-unlock=10005:10005:0700", "-dir", "/run/tacy-tasks=10003:10003:0700"]
  agentd:
    image: ghcr.io/tacyhq/tacy/agentd@sha256:fa54513dd9bd8a8861bed1f15b4cd8012919cb2664d8bbce54ea6e36d6ed3509
    entrypoint: ["/tacy/agentd"]
    network_mode: none
    restart: unless-stopped
    logging:
      driver: none
    ulimits:
      core: 0
    depends_on:
      setup:
        condition: service_completed_successfully
    user: "10003:10003"
    read_only: true
    cap_drop: [ALL]
    security_opt: ["no-new-privileges:true"]
    group_add: ["10001", "10005"]
    volumes:
      - runnersock:/run/tacy/runner
      - agentsock:/run/tacy/agent
      - unlockagent:/run/tacy/unlock
      - /run/tacy-tasks:/run/tacy-tasks
    command: ["-runner-socket", "/run/tacy/runner/runner.sock", "-gateway-socket", "/run/tacy/agent/gateway.sock", "-listen-unix", "/run/tacy/agent/http.sock", "-listen-uid", "10001", "-listen-gid", "10001", "-mem-limit-mib", "600", "-relay-auth-key", "ed25519:HwAuJy8LJPfmHSB0nECuC9OD2PzXVKVn7+wdm89pWIo=", "-unlock-socket", "/run/tacy/unlock/agentd.sock", "-state", "relay", "-firm", "f_chat", "-personal-spaces", "-operator-key", "ed25519:UjnT9P6APMBeNg5pJlGCLbwOKDlVJQO3m3+yDzby2os=", "-keylog-genesis", "a35f4cb79bd5066638a0fd0aa8dc855b951febba003e6a6fd3e335adc8d47cfd", "-keylog-carry", "e6f08a761337f9a367594c3ed43a07723ac50cbf790f5b740e25442d9a8c7496,b1cf194b7246c31a565f7c11de8416f16c377a461976dd9eb8a4e290cef1fe1a", "-tasks-dir", "/run/tacy-tasks"]
  runner:
    image: ghcr.io/tacyhq/tacy/runnerd@sha256:989357aeb6526b7e688c8a10827f6e84c53d2ac8890542ff800e0c121fe00e41
    entrypoint: ["/tacy/runnerd"]
    network_mode: none
    restart: unless-stopped
    logging:
      driver: none
    ulimits:
      core: 0
    depends_on:
      setup:
        condition: service_completed_successfully
    user: "10004:10003"
    read_only: true
    cap_drop: [ALL]
    security_opt: ["no-new-privileges:true", "seccomp:unconfined"]
    mem_limit: 640m
    memswap_limit: 640m
    pids_limit: 512
    tmpfs: ["/run/runner:exec,size=64m,mode=0700,uid=10004,gid=10003", "/tmp:size=16m"]
    volumes:
      - runnersock:/run/tacy/runner
    command: ["-socket", "/run/tacy/runner/runner.sock", "-agent-uid", "10003", "-gvisor", "/tacy/gvisor", "-gvisor-release", "20261012.0", "-runsc-sha256", "56996c546dbafd5716e1d09e307a131d97eb3b6483c22a1178631751f3e0392f", "-brain", "/tacy/brain", "-brain-sha256", "7c984294c1b91fd5c27fb407d655bb2536b35e427b23b6d5082055e73d88cf60", "-dir", "/run/runner", "-platform", "systrap", "-rootless"]
  agentvm:
    image: ghcr.io/tacyhq/tacy/gatewayd@sha256:e3bf11f7f9f85b3076abcd3301fd983306bfcb6671d62de83744f21e541340a7
    entrypoint: ["/tacy/gatewayd"]
    restart: unless-stopped
    logging:
      driver: none
    ulimits:
      core: 0
    depends_on:
      setup:
        condition: service_completed_successfully
    user: "0:0"
    read_only: true
    cap_drop: [ALL]
    cap_add: [SETGID, SETUID]
    security_opt: ["no-new-privileges:true"]
    tmpfs: ["/tmp:mode=0700,uid=10001,gid=10001", "/run/tunnel:size=1m,mode=0750,uid=10001,gid=10006"]
    volumes:
      - agentsock:/run/tacy/agent
      - vaultsock:/run/tacy/vault
      - opssock:/run/tacy/ops
      - unlockgw:/run/tacy/unlockgw
    environment:
      HOME: /tmp
    command: ["-socket", "/run/tacy/agent/gateway.sock", "-agent-uid", "10003", "-vault-socket", "/run/tacy/vault/vault.sock", "-forward", "/run/tacy/agent/http.sock", "-search-provider", "exa", "-expected-keys", "TINFOIL_API_KEY,EXA_API_KEY,TAVILY_API_KEY", "-state-url", "https://chat.tacy.io", "-ops-socket", "/run/tacy/ops/gateway.sock", "-vault-uid", "10002", "-kms-key", "ed25519:1LPZHjHaCjYvuibeGa0PcuFHEIadIxsp8x9EbNNMmEg=", "-unlock-domain", "tacy.io", "-unlock-admin-keys", "ed25519:9ZU78UPBF2w6xfjTdSGODr5lQD7kTrt0SuLhTl+kOv8=", "-unlock-admin-threshold", "1", "-unlock-socket", "/run/tacy/unlockgw/gateway.sock", "-unlockd-uid", "10005", "-firm", "f_chat", "-personal-spaces", "-operator-key", "ed25519:UjnT9P6APMBeNg5pJlGCLbwOKDlVJQO3m3+yDzby2os=", "-keylog-genesis", "a35f4cb79bd5066638a0fd0aa8dc855b951febba003e6a6fd3e335adc8d47cfd", "-keylog-carry", "e6f08a761337f9a367594c3ed43a07723ac50cbf790f5b740e25442d9a8c7496,b1cf194b7246c31a565f7c11de8416f16c377a461976dd9eb8a4e290cef1fe1a", "-safety-url", "https://chat.tacy.io/api/safety/docs", "-keylog-url", "https://chat.tacy.io/api/safety/keylog", "-dns-tls", "dns.quad9.net@9.9.9.9:853,149.112.112.112:853", "-tunnel-uid", "10006", "-cloudflared", "/tacy/cloudflared", "-cloudflared-sha256", "1c8c92c803f5d919c51bf01e1ce8d642d3ec05b51326c214eff756ed4221f0dd", "-cloudflared-access", "baldcactus,4b3edae68fd8b0f6913601a52763b6ab048dcf3981a9d5669efec249530bb00b", "-tunnel-secret", "CF_TUNNEL_TOKEN_VMA"]
  vaultd:
    image: ghcr.io/tacyhq/tacy/vaultd@sha256:81b2a1720e5d6f2ca326a60843939c2cc21fa78142fe1ca89780c61be6b5bc2f
    entrypoint: ["/tacy/vaultd"]
    network_mode: none
    restart: unless-stopped
    logging:
      driver: none
    ulimits:
      core: 0
    depends_on:
      setup:
        condition: service_completed_successfully
    user: "10002:10001"
    read_only: true
    cap_drop: [ALL]
    security_opt: ["no-new-privileges:true"]
    group_add: ["10005"]
    volumes:
      - vaultsock:/run/tacy/vault
      - opssock:/run/tacy/ops
      - unlockvault:/run/tacy/unlockv
    command: ["-socket", "/run/tacy/vault/vault.sock", "-gateway-uid", "10001", "-group-mode", "-unlock-socket", "/run/tacy/unlockv/vaultd.sock", "-ops-socket", "/run/tacy/ops/gateway.sock", "-firm", "f_chat", "-personal-spaces", "-operator-key", "ed25519:UjnT9P6APMBeNg5pJlGCLbwOKDlVJQO3m3+yDzby2os=", "-keylog-genesis", "a35f4cb79bd5066638a0fd0aa8dc855b951febba003e6a6fd3e335adc8d47cfd", "-keylog-carry", "e6f08a761337f9a367594c3ed43a07723ac50cbf790f5b740e25442d9a8c7496,b1cf194b7246c31a565f7c11de8416f16c377a461976dd9eb8a4e290cef1fe1a"]
  unlockd:
    image: ghcr.io/tacyhq/tacy/unlockd@sha256:132d4385627157a82f3c2945c213e8a6d7213e56d199a7df185ab74039cd44fe
    entrypoint: ["/tacy/unlockd"]
    network_mode: none
    restart: unless-stopped
    logging:
      driver: none
    ulimits:
      core: 0
    depends_on:
      setup:
        condition: service_completed_successfully
    user: "10005:10005"
    read_only: true
    cap_drop: [ALL]
    security_opt: ["no-new-privileges:true"]
    group_add: ["10001"]
    volumes:
      - /var/run/dstack.sock:/var/run/dstack.sock
      - /run/tacy-unlock:/run/tacy-unlock
      - unlockagent:/run/tacy/unlock
      - unlockvault:/run/tacy/unlockv
      - unlockgw:/run/tacy/unlockgw
    command: ["-kms-key", "ed25519:1LPZHjHaCjYvuibeGa0PcuFHEIadIxsp8x9EbNNMmEg=", "-unlock-admin-keys", "ed25519:9ZU78UPBF2w6xfjTdSGODr5lQD7kTrt0SuLhTl+kOv8=", "-unlock-admin-threshold", "1", "-min-epoch", "1", "-gateway-socket", "/run/tacy/unlockgw/gateway.sock", "-agent-socket", "/run/tacy/unlock/agentd.sock", "-agent-uid", "10003", "-vault-socket", "/run/tacy/unlockv/vaultd.sock", "-vault-uid", "10002", "-cache-dir", "/run/tacy-unlock", "-key-mode", "none"]
